description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_TargetBlank' that extends a base class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule'. The class is responsible for adding functionality to transform <a> tags to include target="_blank" attributes, as part of the HTML Purifier library's module system.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_TargetBlank
classes.description: A module class that adds target="_blank" attribute handling for <a> tags within the HTML Purifier framework.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by adding a <a> element and attaching a post-attribute transformation to it.
